## Course Structure

::: {.callout-note icon=false}
### Monday March 23 - Rue des Maraîchers Building - Room 102 (morning) & 605 (afternoon)
**Matin** Intro to SPACE-GEOLOGY
- Introduction générale (Gregory Giuliani)
- Principes physiques et images - Satellites et capteurs (Gregory Giuliani)
- Introduction aux TP (Carole Planque, Sébastien Chognard, Audrey Lambiel et Mona Bonnier)
**Après-midi** Lecture: GIS & Remote Sensing in Earth Sciences (G. Giuliani)
- Acquisition d'images satellitaires
- Introduction à la télédétection sur ArcGIS pro
- Création de mosaic de rasters
:::

## More information
 
GEOTOOLS-RS1 is a 3 ECTS course given by the University of Geneva, as part of the [Complementary Certificate of Geomatics](https://www.unige.ch/cgeom/), the [Master in Environmental Sciences](https://www.unige.ch/muse/en), and the [Master in Earth Sciences](https://www.unige.ch/sciences/en/enseignements/formations/masters/earth). 

For questions, please write to [gregory.giuliani@unige.ch](mailto:gregory.giuliani@unige.ch)
